# Predecessor compatibility baseline

`predecessor-api-v1.json` is the public contract copied on 2026-09-28 from
the WebServer-Identify-SpacerPlacer-evOr project. It contains API definitions,
not deployment configuration. The test requires every original route, response
contract, enum value and capability security declaration to remain supported.
It runs without access to any predecessor directory. Backend OpenAPI tests bind
the current frontend contract to the actual application.
